item.title: PHP2Shell in a Box: Building a Local Lab for CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619
item.description: The two 9.2-critical RCEs fixed in PHP 8.2.35 through 8.5.12 on October 21, 2026, deserve more than a CVE skim. Here is how I stood up the exact vulnerable runtime (PHP 8.5.11 as mod_php, default settings) on a laptop, what the trigger actually looks like on the wire, and where the honest line between 'condition reproduced' and 'server owned' sits.
